testCases.label: Original Simpsons array rendered
testCases.description: Locates the element with id 'original' and asserts that its text matches the comma-separated list of the original Simpsons-related array: Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa, Maggie, Principal Skinner, Mr Burns, Moe, Ned Flanders.

testCases.label: Filtered array rendered
testCases.description: Locates the element with id 'afterFilter' and asserts that its text matches the comma-separated list of the filtered array containing only Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa, Maggie, and Moe.

testCases.label: Mapped array rendered in uppercase
testCases.description: Locates the element with id 'afterMap' and asserts that its text matches the comma-separated list of the mapped array where all names are converted to uppercase.

testCases.label: forEach output displayed
testCases.description: Locates the element with id 'consoleOutput' (assumed to mirror the console.log output of the forEach call) and asserts that its text contains each of the original array items: Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa, Maggie, Principal Skinner, Mr Burns, Moe, and Ned Flanders.
